periods.time: Daily routines observed indirectly by Kagami
periods.label: 晨练与训练中的一辉

status.current: maintains severe physical and sword training routines that Stella follows

personality.summary: Disciplined and mild-looking but capable of frighteningly intense training and combat logic.

habits.daily_routine: Runs before dawn with Stella, eats lunch with Stella, Shizuku and Alice, and trains in free afternoons when no match is scheduled.

relationships.stella-vermillion: Training partner and lover; he says direct sparring with Stella could accidentally become a deathmatch.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Older brother whose presence defines Shizuku's emotional world and online activity; teaches her short-sword techniques.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Lunch companion and Shizuku's sparring partner.
relationships.kagami-kusakabe: Kagami uses his training pace and relationships as key evidence in both profiles.

periods.summary: Ikki appears mostly through Kagami's observations of Stella and Shizuku. He runs at dawn with Stella at a pace that exhausts Kagami, eats lunch with the usual four-person group, trains with Stella but avoids direct sparring because it could become a deathmatch, and is the focus of Shizuku's devotion and fan-thread posting.

key_events.summary: Runs and trains with Stella; his shirt becomes Stella's secret object of affection.
Referenced as Shizuku's brother, online obsession and sword teacher.
